mapper.select: SELECT questionId, MAX(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted, MAX(CASE WHEN status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND questionId IN (SELECT id FROM question WHERE isDelete = 0) GROUP BY questionId
